cards.example_en: Draw this angle carefully on your geometry paper.
cards.example_zh: 在几何纸上把这个角仔细画出来。

cards.example_en: I twisted my ankle on the stairs at home yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我在家里的楼梯上把脚踝扭伤了。

cards.example_en: The principal will announce the winners at assembly.
cards.example_zh: 校长将在集会上宣布获胜者。

cards.example_en: Mosquitoes annoy us when we eat outdoors in summer.
cards.example_zh: 夏天我们在外面吃饭的时候，蚊子会惹恼我们。

cards.example_en: Our annual school fair raises money for new library books.
cards.example_zh: 我们一年一度的学校义卖为图书馆的新书筹款。

cards.example_en: We anticipate a rise in prices.
cards.example_zh: 我们预计价格会上涨。

cards.example_en: That antique clock still rings in my grandfather's house.
cards.example_zh: 那座古董钟在我爷爷家里还会响。

cards.example_en: Exam anxiety kept her awake the night before history.
cards.example_zh: 历史考试的前一天夜里，她焦虑得睡不着。

cards.example_en: She was anxious about the job interview.
cards.example_zh: 她对求职面试很着急。

cards.example_en: Anyhow, we arrived on time.
cards.example_zh: 不管怎样，我们准时到了。

cards.example_en: The two shops are far apart.
cards.example_zh: 两家店相距很远。

cards.example_en: You should apologise to her for spilling the juice.
cards.example_zh: 你应该为洒了果汁向她道歉。

cards.example_en: Apparently, the bus is late.
cards.example_zh: 显然，公交车晚点了。

cards.example_en: Camping in the rain doesn't appeal to me.
cards.example_zh: 雨中露营对我没有吸引力。

cards.example_en: A long hike gave me a huge appetite for noodles.
cards.example_zh: 走了很长的路以后，我特别想吃面条。

cards.example_en: The crowd will applaud when the dancers bow.
cards.example_zh: 舞者鞠躬的时候，观众会拍手喝彩。

cards.example_en: Every applicant must fill in this form.
cards.example_zh: 每位申请人都必须填这张表。

cards.example_en: I sent my application to the summer science camp.
cards.example_zh: 我把申请书寄给了暑期科学营。

cards.example_en: Graduates apply for summer jobs at the local hospital.
cards.example_zh: 毕业生向当地医院申请暑期工作。

cards.example_en: I've got a doctor's appointment at three.
cards.example_zh: 我三点要去看医生。

cards.example_en: I really appreciate your help with my science project.
cards.example_zh: 我非常感激你帮我做科学项目。

cards.example_en: Our approach to the stadium was slow in the snow.
cards.example_zh: 雪地里，我们走近体育场时速度很慢。

cards.example_en: Jeans are not appropriate for the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 牛仔裤不适合参加会议。

cards.example_en: Parents must approve the camp form before Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 家长必须在周四之前批准这份夏令营表格。

cards.example_en: We walked under a stone arch.
cards.example_zh: 我们从一座石拱门下走过。

cards.example_en: The architect showed us a model of the new hospital.
cards.example_zh: 建筑师给我们看了新医院的模型。

cards.example_en: Problems arise when nobody locks the bicycle shed.
cards.example_zh: 要是没人锁自行车棚，问题就会出现。

cards.example_en: The alphabetical arrangement made our class list easy to read.
cards.example_zh: 名字按字母排列，我们的班级名单就好读了。

cards.example_en: The arrest of the thief was on the evening news.
cards.example_zh: 那个小偷被逮捕的消息上了晚间新闻。

cards.example_en: His arrow hit the centre of the target in PE.
cards.example_zh: 体育课上，他射出的箭正中靶心。

cards.example_en: These artificial flowers do not need water or sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 这些人造花不需要水和阳光。

cards.example_en: He felt ashamed after copying answers during the quiz.
cards.example_zh: 他在测验中抄了答案，事后感到羞愧。

cards.example_en: Please step aside.
cards.example_zh: 请往旁边让一让。

cards.example_en: Teamwork is one aspect of a good class project.
cards.example_zh: 团队合作是做好课堂作业的一个方面。

cards.example_en: The teacher will assess your speaking skills.
cards.example_zh: 老师会评估你的口语。

cards.example_en: Our director will assign roles for the spring play.
cards.example_zh: 我们的导演会为春季话剧分配角色。

cards.example_en: The assistant coach timed every lap on the running track.
cards.example_zh: 助理教练在跑道上给每一圈计时。

cards.example_en: The parents' association organised the spring fair.
cards.example_zh: 家长协会组织了春季义卖。

cards.example_en: I assume you have read the report.
cards.example_zh: 我猜你已经看过报告了。

cards.example_en: That assumption turned out to be wrong.
cards.example_zh: 那个假定结果是错的。

cards.example_en: The result will astonish the whole class.
cards.example_zh: 这个结果会让全班惊讶。

cards.example_en: The astronomer let us look at the moon through a telescope.
cards.example_zh: 天文学家让我们用望远镜观看月亮。

cards.example_en: Ships cross the Atlantic with food for our city.
cards.example_zh: 轮船载着运给我们城市的食物横渡大西洋。

cards.example_en: Scientists study the atmosphere above the high mountains.
cards.example_zh: 科学家在研究高山上方的大气。

cards.example_en: Please attach a photo to the form.
cards.example_zh: 请在表格中附上照片。

cards.example_en: Daily practice can help you attain a faster swimming time.
cards.example_zh: 每天练习能帮你达到更快的游泳成绩。

cards.example_en: He passed his driving test at the first attempt.
cards.example_zh: 他第一次尝试就通过了驾驶考试。

cards.example_en: She has a positive attitude to life.
cards.example_zh: 她对生活持积极态度。

cards.example_en: Bright colors attract bees to the flowers by the wall.
cards.example_zh: 鲜艳的颜色把蜜蜂吸引到墙边的花上。

cards.example_en: The audience clapped when the dancers left the stage.
cards.example_zh: 舞者走下舞台时，观众鼓起掌来。

word.example_en: They are anxious to see the score.
Apart from rain, the field trip went well.
word.example_zh: 除了下雨，实地考察进行得很顺利。

word.example_en: Short stories appeal to many readers.
word.example_zh: 短篇故事吸引许多读者。

word.example_en: He has an appetite for hard puzzles.
This rule does not apply to visitors.
word.example_zh: 这条规则对参观者不适用。

word.example_en: She will apply for the city scholarship.
word.example_zh: 她将申请那项市级奖学金。

word.example_en: Her approach to revision is slow and steady.
word.example_zh: 她处理复习的途径是慢而稳。

word.example_en: A quiet tone is appropriate to a formal letter.
word.example_zh: 安静的语气与正式信件相称。

word.example_en: The film is appropriate for Grade 10.
Her parents approve of the reading club.
word.example_zh: 她父母赞同这个读书社。

word.example_en: The arrangement for the trip is ready.
word.example_zh: 为这次出行做的安排已经就绪。

word.example_en: Put aside your phone during the lecture.
word.example_zh: 讲座期间暂时放下手机。

word.example_en: Set aside twenty minutes for dictation.
Please attach a photo to the form.
word.example_zh: 请把一张照片附在表格上。

word.example_en: The first attempt at the poem failed.
word.example_zh: 对这首诗的第一次尝试失败了。

word.example_en: His attitude to failure is calm.
word.example_zh: 他对失败的态度很平静。
